brief.text:
GANGSTAS PARADISE (Sleeper) — lineup unchanged, one schedule correction: Herbert/Hampton's Week 1 opponent is ARI at home (SoFi), not KC in Brazil as an earlier report said
Do now: nothing — lineup is set
Locks next 24h: none — first kickoff is Wed 5:20 PM PT (Myers vs NE on the Yahoo side), about 2.5 days out; Sleeper's first game is Herbert/Hampton Sun 1:25 PM PT vs ARI
Lineup: no changes since this morning. Higgins (heel), Flowers (quad) and Downs (calf) all still just Questionable and trending toward playing, no formal downgrades. Tuten's illness looks resolved (full practice reported) but Jacksonville hasn't lifted the tag — still starting him. If Higgins, Flowers, or Downs is out: start Diggs. If Tuten is out: start Woody Marks.
Analysis highlights: Hampton draws a smash matchup (ARI ~31st vs RB, 28.5 implied). Chase Brown and Higgins face a tough TB run/pass funnel but ride a 50.5-point game total. Judkins isn't in this league — no flag needed here.

GAME OF THROWS (Yahoo) — lineup unchanged, still a 39% underdog vs GIBBBBBYYYY with no new screenshots since Friday
Do now: nothing — lineup is set
Locks next 24h: none — first kickoff is Wed 5:20 PM PT (Myers vs NE), about 2.5 days out
Lineup: no changes. No Qs on this roster. Judkins draws the toughest matchup on either roster (JAX ~2nd vs RB, only 16.75 implied as a road dog) — no better flex option on your bench, so he stays in, but don't expect a big week. Etienne is a moderate matchup (DET ~14th vs RB) but the clean lead role after Kamara's MCL injury carries him. G. Wilson gets a plus matchup vs. a leaky TEN pass defense, but it's the lowest total on the slate (39.5) so temper expectations.

FYI: Chase Brown starts for you in both leagues and faces the same tough Buccaneers front twice. Your JAX pieces (Sleeper DEF/Strange/Tuten/P.Washington) and Judkins (Yahoo) collide in the same CLE–JAX game — Cleveland's offense ranked 31st in the NFL last year, which is great for your Jaguars side and bad for Judkins. Sleeper opponent AdufortheWin84's RB TreVeyon Henderson has gotten worse, not better — 12 days without practicing, beat writers now saying the Patriots are planning for him to sit — this helps your Week 1 matchup if it holds. His McCaffrey remains on track for the Melbourne opener. Yahoo opponent Arshdeep's three Qs (Jeanty, Nabers, LaPorta) are all trending positive (more practice reps each) but none formally cleared yet. Full Yahoo season schedule (weeks 1–14) is now in the app — new screenshots today filled in weeks 2–4.
